name: Bath Sheba
overview: The Scriptures reveal Bathsheba as a pivotal figure in the history of Israel, introduced in the narrative where King David sees her and commits adultery with her, leading to her pregnancy (2 Samuel 11:2-5). Despite the sin involved, Bathsheba is also identified as the mother of Solomon, through whom God's promise to David is fulfilled (1 Kings 1:11-12). Her story underscores both the consequences of sin and God's sovereign plan in the lineage of the Messiah.
